title_sq: APARTAMENT 3+1+2 PER SHITJE TE LIQENI I FARKES!
description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e dyte banim ne nje nga komplekset residenciale me cilesore tek Liqeni i Farkes, Lakeland Residences.
Eshte gati per banim.
Ka nje planimetri te rregullt dhe eshte i organizuar ne:
Nje sallon se bashku me kuzhinen dhe akses ne njerin prej ballkoneve
Tre dhoma gjumi, njera prej te cilave me tualet te brendshem dhe akses ne ballkonin e dyte
Dy tualete ne total
Dy ballkone ne total
Prona disponon kontrate porosie dhe pritet qe ne nje kohe te shkurter te posedoje dhe dokumentacionin hipotekor.
Nese deshironi te jetoni ne nje kompleks cilesor dhe te mireadministruar, mes ajerit te paster dhe pak hapa larg Liqenit, ky apartament eshte zhgjedhja e duhur per ju.
Per me shume informacion, apo nje vizite ne prone, mos nguroni te kontaktoni!
title_en: APARTMENT 3+1+2 FOR SALE AT LAKE I FARKE!
description_en: The apartment is located on the second residential floor in one of the highest quality residential complexes in Farka Lake, Lakeland Residences. It is ready for habitation. It has a regular floor plan and is organized in: A living room together with the kitchen and access to one of the balconies Three bedrooms, one of which has an internal toilet and access to the second balcony Two toilets in total Two balconies in total The property has an order contract and is expected to have the mortgage documentation in a short time. If you want to live in a quality and well-managed complex, in the clean air and a few steps away from the Lake, this apartment is the right choice for you. For more information, or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
